programmeBoundary.text: Wordfence Bug Bounty Program, transcribed 2026-10-08. In scope: impact reachable by an unauthenticated visitor, a Subscriber or a Customer. Highest value: arbitrary PHP file upload or read, arbitrary PHP file deletion, arbitrary options update, remote code execution, authentication bypass to admin, privilege escalation to admin. Also in scope: stored XSS, SQL injection, account takeover, sensitive information disclosure. Out of scope: anything needing Contributor, Author, Editor, Shop Manager or Administrator; reflected XSS; denial of service; business-logic-only impact.
